scene: Chapter 5, returned-tenant branch. Jerribeth lives behind the Commander's left eye and has built an exact copy of the Commander's own bedroom inside their mind, down to the crack in the ceiling. The Commander offered their wrists in the imagining; she pinned them into a pillow that does not exist and lowered herself onto them. Everything happens in the imagined room; the real body lies alone, but every sensation is real to it. Her advantage is cruel and intimate: she knows 'where every nerve in this house runs' from the Commander's own memories, uses that knowledge precisely, and repeats whatever breaks their composure. No stolen host body is used. Explicit, unhurried and graphic where the act is, in her own register (precise, possessive, amused); Commander and Jerribeth only. Marhevok's pot, the cabinet's specimens and any host body never take part. End at the stop line.
